name: fail-closed-schema-digest-approval
description: V0 campaign-controller schema pattern: rejectUnknownKeys everywhere, approval digest over canonical JSON (recursively key-sorted) so binding is key-order-independent, timestamps normalized to ISO UTC before digesting, validation clock injected via nowMs for deterministic tests, committed data profiles validated against a FixedClock pinned near fetchedAt

name: read-only-upstream-reconciliation
description: warren-323d: notifications are wake-ups only; facts normalize to repository+kind+nodeId dedupe with payloadDigest; edits append _edit events whose stored digest equals the edited fact's digest so re-polls dedupe; deletions append _deleted tombstones; attention dedupes by workItem|reason|subjectKey against open items; biome complexity ceiling met by splitting deriveAttention/reconcilePullRequest into per-category helpers
